Clinician.description: A nurse, doctor, assistant or student on the hospital's staff list. A first name alone is not an identity.

Ward.description: A hospital ward, known by its ward name.

Supervision.description:
A standing professional link between two clinicians: who supervises, preceptors or provides cover for whom.
Swapping one shift on the rota is not cover.

WardPost.description: A clinician's standing post on a ward: its matron, its nurse in charge or its lead consultant.

Shift.description: One shift on the rota. rostered works it, swapped_with took it over or traded it, approved_by signed it off. A hoped-for shift is not rostered.

Incident.description: A safety incident on a ward. reported_by logged it. escalated stays empty until an escalation is recorded.

questions.q: Who is the matron of Larch Ward?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Ward)-[:matron]->(n1:Clinician) WHERE n0.name = 'Larch Ward' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is in charge of Kingfisher Ward?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Ward)-[:charge]->(n1:Clinician) WHERE n0.name = 'Kingfisher Ward' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the consultant for Ashby Ward?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Ward)-[:consultant]->(n1:Clinician) WHERE n0.name = 'Ashby Ward' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which ward is overseen by me?
questions.speaker: adaeze
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clinician)-[:overseen]->(n1:Ward) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: tamar
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clinician)-[:preceptor]->(n1:Clinician) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is a supervisee of mine?
questions.speaker: ravindra
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clinician)-[:supervisee]->(n1:Clinician) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Clinician)-[:cover]->(n1:Clinician) WHERE n0.name = 'Marguerite Duval' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.incident = 'medication error' RETURN n0.escalated AS escalated

questions.q: Is there a record of the pressure sore being escalated?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.incident = 'pressure sore' RETURN coalesce(n0.escalated, false) AS escalated

questions.q: How many hours is the long day?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Shift) WHERE n0.slot = 'long day' RETURN n0.hours AS hours

questions.q: Which shifts did Lerato Dlamini approve?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clinician)<-[:approved_by]-(n1:Shift) WHERE n0.name = 'Lerato Dlamini' RETURN n1.slot AS slot

questions.q: Who reported incidents on Ashby Ward?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Ward)<-[:ward]-(n1:Incident)-[:reported_by]->(n2:Clinician) WHERE n0.name = 'Ashby Ward' RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: Which slots and hours were worked on Ashby Ward?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Ward)<-[:ward]-(n1:Shift) WHERE n0.name = 'Ashby Ward' RETURN n1.slot AS slot, n1.hours AS hours
MATCH (n0:Shift) WHERE n0.remark CONTAINS 'strike' RETURN n0.slot AS slot

questions.q: Is Tamar Ben-David on call for her shifts?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clinician)<-[:rostered]-(n1:Shift) WHERE n0.name = 'Tamar Ben-David' RETURN n1.on_call AS on_call

questions.q: Is there a record of Paulo Tuilagi being on call?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clinician)<-[:rostered]-(n1:Shift) WHERE n0.name = 'Paulo Tuilagi' RETURN coalesce(n1.on_call, false) AS on_call
